items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I remember Red Allen... I remember reading of him being on the boat, but I don't think I ever saw Louie... But I remember Red, Allen

ctx.x: Yeah, he's still living up there.

Ridgely, uh, last time I saw him was crippled. He must have had a stroke or something. And, uh, I remembered him. Of course, he didn't remember me. I was just a fan, you know. I used to, my father used to take me to ball games on Sunday morning. They were ball games at the old ballpark here, Heinemann Park it was. And he'd take my second brother and I and just let us in the vicinity of the band, you see. They'd have this band playing. It was a tuxedo. And we would sit there and he could roam all over that park.…
I know you've told me that you collect the Armstrong records.
